carmen_cs: FYI PulseGrid onboarding: noticed their chat p95 spikes during morning syncs. Baseline was ~300ms, spiked up to ~900ms yesterday for ~5-10m windows. Want to propose a proactive perf plan (quant + route + cache) ahead of renewal.
noah_se: Oof. Any breakdown by client type or region?
carmen_cs: Mostly mobile web and EU region. Sequence lengths average ~140 tokens but with occasional 600-token long threads. Burstiness from fan-out notifications. Graph: https://redwood.internal/graphs/pulsegrid/chat-p95-2026-03-20
jun_sre: For mixed seq lengths, a blanket int8 can hurt long-context quality. Idea: adaptive model selection: route long sequences to baseline large model, short/medium to compact-int4. Also enable prefix/KV cache for repeated system + assistant context.
tess_pe: Renewal in 5 weeks. We should aim to demonstrate a 25-35% latency improvement for peak windows while keeping golden-set quality loss <0.8%. Carmen, can CS get a 100-sample golden set?
carmen_cs: On it. Will capture 100 live prompts and flag ~20 critical ones.
noah_se: Suggested routing rule (ops-friendly):
```
route: pulsegrid_chat
policies:
  - name: short-path
    weight: dynamic
    selector: request.seq_len <= 200
    model_candidates: [rw-ggml-compact-int4, rw-ggml-compact-ffn]
    max_queue_ms: 80
  - name: long-path
    weight: dynamic
    selector: request.seq_len > 200
    model: rw-ggml-large-v1
    max_queue_ms: 120
fallback: long-path
metrics:
  - quality_check: golden_set_delta <= 0.8%
  - latency_check: p95 <= 600ms
```
jun_sre: I'll also spin up a small dedicated low-latency pool (2x small GPUs) to absorb mobile fan-outs for short-path. Configure autoscale to +1 node if queue > 200ms for 30s.
tess_pe: We'll need a concise pitch for the customer: expected latency delta, estimated token cost delta, and rollback safety. I'll draft slides with before/after sims.
carmen_cs: Plan for canary: 7% traffic to compact-int4 short-path for 24h, real-time quality alerts. If golden_set delta <0.8% and hallucination alerts = 0 -> expand to 30%.
noah_se: Add an experiment: micro-batching tweak: reduce max batch size for short-path to prioritize latency (batch_size 8 -> 4) and enable aggressive batch timeout 12ms. Should lower p95 for interactive flows.
jun_sre: Deploy-bot, schedule canary?
deploy-bot: Canary queued: pulsegrid-compact-shortpath (7%) -> rw-ggml-compact-int4 scheduled 2026-04-06T08:30:00Z. Will emit quality events to #cs-quality.
carmen_cs: Great. I'll post golden prompts and invite list. Thanks team :rocket:
